ud7.2:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud7.2:1.3: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ lakuṇṭhakabhaddiyaṃ sekkhoti maññamāno bhiyyosomattāya anekapariyāyena dhammiyā kathāya sandasseti samādapeti samuttejeti sampahaṃseti.
ud7.2:2.1: addasā kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ sāriputtaṃ āyasmantaṃ lakuṇṭhakabhaddiyaṃ sekkhoti maññamānaṃ bhiyyosomattāya anekapariyāyena dhammiyā kathāya sandassentaṃ samādapentaṃ samuttejentaṃ sampahaṃsentaṃ.
ud7.2:3.1: atha kho bhagavā etamatthaṃ viditvā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ udānaṃ udānesi
